error_cost_preference: Prefer abstention/manual review to unsupported automated assertions; count misses and quiet cases separately. The numerical tradeoff requires operator approval.
fresh_cohort_requirements: Distinct source/occurrence lineage groups for tuning, qualification and final; preserve all prior exposures.
Independent human source labels with exact scope/time and evidence references; no scores/drafts before first pass.
Adequate positive and negative support: the 100 minimum is ACCEPTED groups per enabled polarity, not messages or total corpus rows.

At least 100 tuning plus 100 qualification groups if genuine contrasting cases within each group supply both polarities; disjoint class pools need more. Fit selection/coverage/unknowns can require more still.
Freeze complete corpus, split, source permission, method identities and approved plan before new scored calls. Reserve final split for later evaluation.

Current MAX_EPISODES=256 bounds one complete corpus, including tuning/qualification/final. Paired groups are only valid if real scenario structure supports them; never fabricate pairing to meet the cap.

future_critical_use_proposal.reason: Wrong authority/final-action assertions and unsupported corrections are more harmful. This higher gate is not achievable within the current single-corpus episode cap at the declared confidence.

interval: existing grouped one-sided Clopper-Pearson, Bonferroni across two decision polarities, all accepted cases in a connected lineage group must be correct
question_scope: Exact revision-2 question/renderer/preparation/model identity; public county/city source packets with explicitly declared experimental finance, land-use or school-IT purpose. No transfer to other questions, Google/lobbying profiles, alert writing or production delivery.
use_scope: Capture-only review pilot; not authorization for autonomous client alerts.
